body:
## Completion assessment + what just shipped

This epic is **functionally complete** — every decision (D1–D6) is implemented, merged across all three repos, and live-verified; ADR-0070 is *Accepted*. The checklist boxes above were stale relative to the merged work, so I've ticked them with the PR-by-PR map. Two loose ends were identified; one is now closed, one is intentionally deferred.

### PR map
| Decision | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| D1/D2 kernel reject | ✅ | framework#2285 (`isWritablePackage`, `writable_package_required` 422) |
| D3 Studio create-flow | ✅ | objectui#1970 |
| D3 AI authoring | ✅ | cloud#479 / #481 / #480 (+ #577 / #588 / #590) |
| D4 lifecycle unit | ✅ | framework#2299 (duplicate), objectui#1983 (Duplicate / structure-only delete) |
| D5 migration | ✅ tooling / ◐ tail | framework#2301 + objectui#1983; stopgap-scope removal → **#2359** |
| D6 single-tenant default | ✅ | ADR + objectui#1983 + cloud#588 |
| Dogfood gate | ✅ | framework#2303 (D1/D2) + **framework#2358** (full lifecycle) + cloud#594 / #598 |

### Just shipped — framework#2358 (automated the dogfood gate)
The gate previously only proved the D1/D2 backstop; the rest of the chain was hand-verified. framework#2358 promotes it to an automated proof against the real booted stack: `create → bind → publish → editable → discoverable → delete-cascade`, plus `reassignOrphanedMetadata` (D5) and `duplicatePackage` (D4). `5 passed (5)` locally.

### Remaining tail (deferred by design) → #2359
Removing the #1946 "Local / Custom" selector scope is the last step of D5, but ADR-0070 gates it on environments being **orphan-free** (the adopt-orphans tooling that makes it safe is already merged). Split into #2359 so this epic can close once #2358 merges.

### Recommendation
Close this epic when framework#2358 merges; track the orphan-free stopgap removal under #2359.

## Update — the last D5 tail is now implemented (PR up, CI green)

Since the system is pre-launch, the "migrate envs to orphan-free first" gate on the stopgap removal doesn't apply, so it was removed outright rather than deferred:

- **objectui#2025** — removes the "Local / Custom (this env)" package-selector scope (the `package_id = null` / `sys_metadata` orphan bucket from #1946). `buildPackageScopeOptions` now returns writable bases only; `isLocalScope`/`LOCAL_PACKAGE_ID`/`writableBaseOptions` and the create-flow/list/home special-casing are gone. Read-side `sys_metadata` legacy-provenance handling is kept (ADR-0070 D5). **CI green** (Test, Build & E2E, Changeset, Docs; 931 unit tests). Tracked as #2359.

With this, **all of D1–D6 (including the D5 stopgap removal) are implemented**, and the dogfood gate is automated (framework#2358, also green). Once framework#2358 and objectui#2025 merge, this epic and #2359 can both close — there is no remaining package-first work.
